details: Pfizer never prints Velsipity (etrasimod) revenue on its own line in any earnings release, 10-Q or 10-K from approval (Oct 2023) through the second quarter of 2026. Its Specialty Care product table lists Vyndaqel family, Xeljanz, Cibinqo and other named lines and closes with 'All other Specialty Care'; the FY2023 10-K lists Velsipity among Inflammation & immunology products without revenue. Measured: 0 of 12 releases (2023Q3-2026Q2) carry a Velsipity row with figures. Inferred: Velsipity revenue sits in 'All other Specialty Care' (the filings do not say so).
source_quote: Specialty Care: Inflammation & immunology : Xeljanz, Enbrel (outside the U.S. and Canada), Inflectra, Cibinqo, Litfulo and Velsipity

details: Novo Nordisk never prints Esperoct (turoctocog alfa pegol) as its own line. In every quarterly financial report read (31 reports, the Q4 2018 report through the Q2 2026 report, 6-K exhibits caq{q}{yyyy}.htm; the only table rows that name Esperoct are the footnotes 'Comprises ...'), Esperoct is one of the products inside a larger line: 'Haemophilia' / 'Rare blood disorders', whose footnote lists NovoSeven, NovoEight, Esperoct, Refixia, NovoThirteen (and Alhemo from 2024). Running text gives only a country count for Esperoct (e.g. launched in nine countries, FY2019 report) and, from FY2021, a haemophilia A products class total (which, by inference, is NovoEight plus Esperoct, not Esperoct alone); no Esperoct sales figure appears in any table or sentence. No quarterly series can be cited without interpolation or summation across products, so none is staged.
source_quote: Rare blood disorders 6 | 2,896 | (6%) | (4%) | 5,529 ... 6) Comprises NovoSeven, NovoEight, Esperoct, Refixia, NovoThirteen and Alhemo.

details: Teva never prints Cinqair (Cinqaero outside the U.S.) revenue as a line, a figure or a table row in any 6-K, 8-K, 10-Q, 10-K or 20-F from April 2016 to September 2026; it is folded into 'specialty respiratory products' (ProAir, QVAR, DuoResp Spiromax, Qnasl and Cinqair in Q2 2016) and, in the segment tables from 2018, into the generic 'Other' or the respiratory lines. Launch was April 2016 (U.S.).
source_quote: Our respiratory portfolio includes ProAir ® , QVAR ® , DuoResp Spiromax ® , Qnasl ® and Cinqair ® . Revenues from our specialty respiratory products in the second quarter of 2016 were $313 million, an increase of 24% compared to the second quarter of 2015.
